The '''bloodline''' of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Victun]], a member of the ruling [[Dark Council]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], was eradicated<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4043 BBY]]<ref name="Time" /> on the orders of the Dark Council. The order was issued after Victun and his rival [[Darth Qalar]] destroyed the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] in a [[Kaggath (c. 4043 BBY)|Kaggath]], or ritual [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] duel. Victun and Qalar were both [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the rest of the Council after their duel, and their family lines were eliminated as further punishment.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
